heading: Sidharth Malhotra gets nostalgic about ‘Student Of The Year’ co-stars Varun Dhawan, Alia Bhatt ahead of ‘Vvaan’ release with Tamannaah Bhatia
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in /  Sep 21, 2026, 11:27 IST
paragraphs: Sidharth Malhotra is set to appear on the upcoming episode of ‘Family Full House with Rohit Sharma’, where the actor will be seen alongside his ‘Vvaan’ co-star Tamannaah Bhatia

The episode promises an entertaining mix of celebrity banter, games and personal revelations, with Sidharth opening up about his journey in the film industry.The show, hosted by former Indian cricket captain Rohit Sharma, brings celebrities and their families together for a series of interactive games

After its premiere on September 19, the upcoming episode will feature Sidharth, Tamannaah, choreographer Bosco Martis and others competing against each other.During the episode, Sidharth takes a trip down memory lane while discussing the co-stars who hold a special place in his career

The actor names Varun Dhawan and Alia Bhatt, with whom he made his Bollywood debut in ‘Student of the Year’ (2012), as his favourite co-stars.“The candid revelation offered a glimpse into Sidharth’s early days in the industry and the memories he continues to cherish
Sidharth said, ‘I have worked with many co-stars, but the ones coming to my mind right now are my first co-stars Varun and Alia

We put in a lot of hard work together.”Reflecting on 'Student of the Year' daysSidharth also recalls how much preparation went into ‘Student of the Year’, particularly the nervousness and anxiety surrounding his first major acting project

He reportedly spoke about the rehearsals and preparation that he, Varun and Alia underwent while making the film.The experience marked the beginning of their respective journeys as leading Bollywood actors, and Sidharth continues to remember the camaraderie they developed during that phase.The upcoming episode also comes at a significant time for Sidharth, who is gearing up for his next film ‘Vvaan’

The actor stars opposite Tamannaah Bhatia in the project, making their appearance together on ‘Family Full House with Rohit Sharma’ particularly relevant for fans awaiting the film.Sidharth and Tamannaah are expected to bring their on-screen pairing into the spotlight as they participate in the show's games and interactions with Rohit Sharma.Rohit Sharma turns television host‘Family Full House with Rohit Sharma’ marks the former cricketer’s television hosting debut

The show combines celebrity appearances with family-oriented games, giving viewers an opportunity to see popular personalities in a more informal setting.The series premiered on September 19, which also marked the anniversary of Rohit’s T20I debut for India in 2007
